feed_summary: Written by: Jayson Frost, Bryce Greathouse, Dhanesh Kizhakkinan, John Palmisano, Steve Rasch, Daniel Sislo, John Wolfram Introduction On Oct. 15, 2026, Mandiant and Google Threat Intelligence Group (GTIG) published a blog post detailing recent activity in which the suspected PRC-nexus threat actor ARMORY CASTLE (formerly tracked as UNC5221) exploited CVE-2026-102764, a zero-day vulnerability in BeyondTrust Remote Support, which was patched in BT26-05 . We also described some of the threat actor’s post-exploitation operations. In this blog we describe additional post-compromise activity involving the exploitation of a vulnerability in VMware vCenter and the deployment of additional malware families.
